record.field: SQL: views, window functions, performance, injection
Publish the results of the charity run with SQL, speed up the amounts raised, close a security hole and catch a cheater.

field.name: description
field.p: La Course du Cœur is a 10 km charity run: for each kilometre covered by a runner, their sponsors give money to the association. Three editions, 1 800 runners, thousands of split times: the module trivia_charity_run has all the data, but the results are missing, the list of the runners is slow, the results kiosk has a security hole… and someone cheated.
To explore the data, open a PostgreSQL console: make psql (on Odoo.sh: the Shell tab, then psql). The TODOs of the code are numbered like the tasks below.

ol.li: The results (report/run_result_report.py): write the SQL view of the results: the time, the pace and the ranks of each runner who reached the finish.
Performance (models/run_runner.py, models/run_split.py): compute the amount raised without running one query per runner, and add the missing index on the split times of the runners.
Security (models/run_runner.py): search_by_bib_or_name() is open to SQL injection, and it cannot even find Seán O'Brien. Fix it.

The cheater: in the last edition, a runner took a shortcut: between km 5 and km 10, their time is faster than the world record of the 5 km (12 min 35 s). Find them with SQL, then disqualify them (button on the form of the runner).

field.p: ⭐ Bonus: the disqualified runners are not in the results, and the ranks are computed without them; a pivot view and a graph view of the results.
💡 After a change of Python code, update the modules (make update): the SQL view is created again by init().
